title: Kissed Salty Jamaican Chicken Skillet
description: A salty, velvety, and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring tamarind paste, perfect for a brunch mood, and Whole30-friendly. This skillet dish combines the richness of chicken and spices with the tanginess of tamarind paste.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tamarind paste, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in 1/4 cup of water to emulsify the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
